Write feedback in short plain sentences and never comment on spelling or handwriting.

Question 21(b) [6 marks]: Discuss ONE internal and ONE external source of finance for Sue's purchase of stock.
STIMULUS / CASE INFORMATION:
Sue is a sole trader whose business is growing rapidly as sales are increasing. As a result of the growth, she needs to purchase stock worth $10 000.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 6):
6 marks: Provides points for and/or against one internal and one external source of finance for this purchase
5 marks: Provides points for and/or against one internal source and provides a point for or against an external source OR | Provides points for and/or against one external source and provides a point for or against an internal source
4 marks: Provides points for and/or against one internal source of finance and sketches in general terms one external source of finance OR | Provides points for and/or against one external source of finance and sketches in general terms one internal source of finance
3 marks: Provides points for and/or against one source of finance OR | Sketches both internal and external sources of finance
2 marks: Provides a point for or against one source of finance OR names one external and one internal source of finance
1 marks: Names one source of finance

SAMPLE ANSWER (official):
Sue could consider using retained profits for this purchase. This would be a lower risk option as it does not add to her gearing. It could however significantly reduce her cash flow. She could also use a mortgage. This would be a lower interest rate than many other types of loan but she would be using a long-term loan for a short-term purpose. Sue would still be paying back the mortgage years after the stock has been sold.
